title: Compatibility of a term and restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates with distinct coordinates, and let $\rho$ assign each coordinate a status of free, fixed to $+1$, or fixed to $-1$. The term is compatible with $\rho$ if there exists a binary assignment to the free coordinates such that, after completing it using the fixed values specified by $\rho$, the term evaluates to $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: term with pairwise distinct literal coordinates
